**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (insert).**

- **Investigation:** No termination-effects provision exists. §13 (p0078) only obliges *Client* to arrange a new name server/hosting environment within 30/60 days; §14 (p0079) merely runs services to month-end after Client's notice; §10 Confidentiality (p0061–p0068) contains no return-or-destroy obligation on TrueLink; §24 survival (p0090) adds nothing on data. No export, deletion-timing or migration-assistance language anywhere.
- **Classification:** Fails the fallback outright (no assistance period, no export deadline), so actionable rather than a rationale-only note.
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` p0079 adding new §14a at the preferred level — six months' transition assistance at TrueLink's then-current rates, return of Client Content and other Client data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. All six preferred elements carried by the single operation; no survival tails or other non-element extras added, and neighbouring clauses left verbatim.
